STEP 1 - Scene: A plated dinner with baked/breaded chicken pieces, a creamy green salad (lettuce/cucumber/herbs in dressing), and roasted Brussels sprouts.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × (13)² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Breaded/herb-crusted chicken pieces (two pieces)
- Creamy salad (leafy greens, cucumber, herbs, dressing)
- Roasted Brussels sprouts (about 5 small)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate):
- Chicken: ~22% (≈117 cm²)
- Creamy salad: ~20% (≈106 cm²)
- Brussels sprouts: ~5% (≈27 cm²)
- Total food coverage ≈ 47%

STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):
- Chicken: 117 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 175 ml
- Salad: 106 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 265 ml
- Sprouts: 27 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 40 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Chicken: 175 ml × 0.95 ≈ 166 g
- Salad (dressed mixed greens with cucumber, mostly leafy): 265 ml × 0.15 ≈ 40 g. Dressing adds a little; using a creamy-dressed density of about 0.3 gives ≈ 80 g. I'll take ~70 g.
- Sprouts: 40 ml × 0.6 ≈ 24 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken (breaded, baked, cooked): 166 g × 200 kcal/100 g ≈ 332 kcal (breading and some fat included)
- Creamy salad (dressed greens): 70 g × 60 kcal/100 g ≈ 42 kcal
- Brussels sprouts (roasted/cooked): 24 g × 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 10 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Roughly half a dinner plate of food, with a moderate-size chicken portion and a small salad and sprouts. Total ≈ 260 g and ≈ 384 kcal is plausible for what is visible.

Total: about 260 g, about 384 kcal.
